transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hi. Well, I guess I'm here because for the last couple of years, I just feel low all the time. It's like... even when I'm at work, or at church, or around people I care about, there's just this heavy, empty feeling. It doesn't really ever lift.
During these last couple of years, has there ever been a stretch of two months or more when you did not feel low?

No... I really don't think so. It's been pretty constant. I mean, I might have a decent day here or there, but definitely not two whole months of feeling okay. It's just been this same heavy feeling the whole time.
Do you often feel bad about yourself?

Not really. I mean, I don't feel great, obviously, but I don't sit around hating myself or anything like that. It's more just... I'm just tired and empty. I don't think I'm a bad person, I just don't feel good.

No, I wouldn't say hopeless. I mean... I don't feel like everything is doomed or that there's no point to anything. It's not like that. I know things could be better, I just... I just feel flat and tired all the time. But no, not hopeless.
During this time, have you ever had a period when the depression felt much worse than your usual baseline?

No, I don't think so. It's just... it's always just this same level of heavy. I haven't really had a time where it suddenly got a lot worse than how I usually feel. It's pretty much just stayed exactly the same this whole time.
Do you often feel anxious or worried?

No, not really anxious. I mean, I worry about normal things sometimes, but it's not a big problem. It's mostly just the tiredness and feeling empty, like I said. I don't get all worked up or nervous about things.
